items.title: Help prevent out-of-memory restarts on Aurora MySQL 8.4
items.summary: Out-of-memory restarts drop every connection and force an Aurora MySQL cluster restart. Learn how Aurora MySQL 8.4's automatic memory management prevents them: confirm protection is active, read the signals during a memory-pressure event, monitor OOM avoidance with CloudWatch, and decide when to take manual control.
items.creator: Aayushi Mittal

items.title: Diagnose Amazon Aurora MySQL performance using CloudWatch Database Insights
items.summary: When an Aurora MySQL or Amazon RDS for MySQL database slows down, it can be hard to tell why. This post shows how to read DB load in Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights, interpret the most common MySQL wait events, and turn each into a concrete action, so you can fix the real bottleneck instead of scaling up to a larger instance.
items.creator: Aayushi Mittal

items.title: Automate Aurora zero-ETL recovery after global failover
items.summary: After an Amazon Aurora Global Database switchover or failover, the Aurora zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift keeps referencing the former primary and stops ingesting. Learn how to automate integration recreation with Amazon EventBridge and AWS Lambda so your analytics pipeline recovers without manual intervention.
items.creator: Aritra Biswas
